group: Standalone cash-settled products — inventory rows 3, 7, 12, 26, 32, 39, 40 (41 roots)
is_trade_type_variant:
MIXED, and the split is now settled from primary documents rather than guessed.

ROW 3 IS THE ONLY ROW WITH TRADE-TYPE VARIANTS, and it is exactly 9 underlying contracts + their 9 BTIC codes. Root->description from market-hours-root-classification.tsv: AW=BLOOMBERG COMM INDEX FUTURES (70/AW) and AWT=BTIC BLOOMBERG COMM INDEX (70/B7); BAG(70/7A)/BAT(70/8G); BEN(70/7E)/BET(70/8R); BGR(70/7G)/BGT(70/8S); BLI(70/7L)/BLT(70/8U); BME(70/7M)/BMT(70/8T); BPE(70/7H)/BPT(70/8Q); BPR(70/7R)/BST(70/8X); CCI=FTSE CORE COMMODITY CRB INDEX FUTURES (70/FW)/CCT=BTIC FTSE CORE COMMODITY CRB INDEX (70/FX).

The BTIC codes are TRADE-TYPE VARIANTS, not product families. CME's own initial-listing certifications put the BTIC code in a "BTIC Code" row of the SAME contract, under ONE rulebook chapter, with ONE "Trading and Clearing Hours" block: CBOT Submission 25-093 lists "CME Globex and CME ClearPort Code: BAG / BGR / BLI / BEN / BPE / BME / BPR" directly above "BTIC Code: BAT / BGT / BLT / BET / BPT / BMT / BST", chapters 29E-29K, then a single hours block "CME Globex: Monday - Friday 8:15 a.m. - 1:30 p.m. CT". CME Submission 25-215 does the same for the CRB: "CME Globex and CME ClearPort Code CCI / BTIC Code CCT / Rulebook Chapter 414", one hours block "CME Globex: Monday - Friday 8:15 a.m. - 1:30 p.m. CT". And CME's Bloomberg Commodity Index contract specification prints "Product Code CME Globex: AW CME ClearPort: 70 Clearing: 70 BTIC: AWT" against a single "Trading Hours CME Globex: MON-FRI 8:15am-1:30pm". CME does maintain a separate Globex security group per BTIC code (70/B7, 70/8G, ...), but in the 2026-08-30 TradingSessionList all 18 groups carry one byte-identical transition signature (sha ea2783d2...): Pre-Open Sun 16:00 CT / Mon-Thu 16:45 CT, Ready 08:15 CT, Close 13:30 CT.

ONE RESIDUAL CONFLICT, reported not resolved: CME Submission 23-074 (2023) tabulates a BTIC-specific window for BCOM — "Bloomberg Commodity Index Futures | AW | CBOT 29 | Current CME Globex BTIC Trading Hours 5:00 pm - 1:30pm CT | No change" — which does not equal the contract spec's 08:15-13:30 for the same contract. The 17:00 start coincides with the long overnight Pre-Open the schedule file shows, but I did not retrieve a document that says so, so I am not asserting it.

ROWS 7, 12, 26, 32, 39, 40 contain NO trade-type variants. Every root there is an outright futures contract: 11 city/composite codes of one housing contract; 6 dairy contracts; 2 lumber contracts; 1 Santos soy; 1 urea; 1 Black Sea wheat. Separately, the TERMINATION/SETTLEMENT trap was checked on every row and each daily close below is stated by CME under a session heading ("CME Globex:", "Trading Hours", "Trading and Clearing Hours"), with Termination of Trading printed as a distinct row in the same table.
roots_to_existing_keys: NONE. No root in rows 3, 7, 12, 26, 32, 39 or 40 maps to any key in docs/schedules/verification.md (globex_equity_index, globex_energy, globex_grains, globex_mini_grains, globex_fx, globex_interest_rates, globex_livestock, globex_cryptocurrency, globex_nikkei_225_dollar, globex_rough_rice, globex_weather, cfe_vix, eurex, eurex_fixed_income, ice_us*, sgx*, always_open). Two near-misses are deliberately rejected below.
roots_needing_new_keys: ROW 3a - AW, BAG, BEN, BGR, BLI, BME, BPE, BPR (+ BTIC variants AWT, BAT, BET, BGT, BLT, BMT, BPT, BST on the same key, no key of their own) -> proposed `globex_bloomberg_commodity_index`. Grid: CME Globex Mon-Fri 08:15-13:30 CT; the 2026-08-30 schedule file adds a long order-entry Pre-Open (Sun 16:00 CT, Mon-Thu 16:45 CT) running to the 08:15 open. Sourced: AW at 08:15-13:30 by CME's own contract spec captured 2015-09-12, 2019-10-14 and 2021-06-22; the seven subindices at 08:15-13:30 by CBOT Submission 25-093, effective Sunday 2025-03-30 for trade date Monday 2025-03-31. STILL NEEDS SOURCING: (i) AW's history before 2015-09-12 - the contract was renamed from Dow Jones-UBS Commodity Index, so under the repo's knowledge-boundary rule the DJ-UBS-era pages must be read on their own terms before any pre-2014 row is keyed; (ii) the Pre-Open onsets, which no retrieved primary document states (25-093 prints an implausible 'CME Globex Pre-Open: 4:45 p.m. - 5:00 p.m. CT'); (iii) the 23-074 BTIC-hours conflict above; (iv) RTH/ETH classification - CME product metadata gives pitEligible=0 for BAG (productId 10209), so the weather precedent (no regular session in any era) is the likely reading but is not yet sourced.

ROW 3b - CCI (+ BTIC variant CCT on the same key) -> proposed `globex_ftse_crb_index`. Separate key from 3a on repo law ('give a family its own named profile even when its hours currently coincide'): different exchange (XCME vs XCBT), different rulebook chapter (CME 414 vs CBOT 29/29E-29K), different launch date. Grid: 'CME Globex: Monday - Friday 8:15 a.m. - 1:30 p.m. CT', pre-open 'Monday - Friday 4:45 p.m. - 8:15 a.m. Central Time/CT (Sunday CME Globex Pre-Open begins at 5:00 p.m. CT)', from CME Submission 25-215, effective Sunday 2025-07-20 for trade date Monday 2025-07-21. Pre-launch era is a closure. STILL NEEDS SOURCING: the Sunday Pre-Open - 25-215 says 17:00 CT, the 2026-08-30 schedule file shows 16:00 CT (Pre-Open at 20260830210000 UTC); that one-hour gap is undated and must not be invented.

ROW 7 - BOS, CHI, CUS, DEN, LAV, LAX, MIA, NYM, SDG, SFR, WDC -> proposed `globex_housing_index` (CME Metro Area / Composite Housing Index futures, S&P CoreLogic Case-Shiller, productId 802, Globex group 70/HI, pitEligible=0). One family, and CME's own spec enumerates exactly these eleven codes. Current grid: 'Monday - Friday 8:15 a.m. - 3:00 p.m. CT', corroborated by the 2026-08-30 schedule file (Pre-Open 08:00 CT, Ready 08:15 CT, Close 15:00 CT, five identical weekdays). One dated revision available: CME Submission 13-344 changed the grid from '5:00 PM Central Time to 2:00 PM Central Time (next day)' to '8:15 AM Central Time to 3:00 PM Central Time', which also states the outgoing floor-era grid for the January-2010 carry-back. STILL NEEDS SOURCING: the effective day. 13-344's letter says 'trade day, Tuesday, September 3, 2013'; the draft SER inside the same filing says 'effective for trade date of Monday, September 2, 2013' - which was US Labor Day. The final SER must settle this before a revision row is keyed. Also unsourced: the 08:00 Pre-Open onset.

ROW 12 - CB, CSC, DC, DY, GDK, GNF -> proposed `globex_dairy` (CME Cash-Settled Butter ch.56, Cash-Settled Cheese ch.6003, Class III Milk ch.52, Dry Whey ch.57, Class IV Milk ch.55, Nonfat Dry Milk ch.54; Globex groups 70/CB, 70/DC, 70/DY). Grid: Sunday 17:00 CT running to Friday 13:55 CT with a daily 16:00-17:00 CT trading halt - i.e. the Friday 13:55 close is a genuine weekly session close, stated by CME under the 'CME Globex' venue heading, and is NOT the 12:10 CT termination-of-trading instant printed one row below it. Sourced for all six roots and stable across 2013-05-18 (Class III), 2019-10-18 (Cheese) and the 2025-08-11 / 2026-08-10 spec captures (Class III, Class IV, Butter, Dry Whey, Nonfat Dry Milk). STILL NEEDS SOURCING: (i) whether anything changed between the January-2010 floor and the 2013-05-18 capture - the only dairy hours filings I found in the CFTC DCM index are pre-floor (CME #08-159 of 2008-10-17 'Amends the Globex trading times for CME Meat, Livestock and Dairy products' and CME #09-236 of 2009-10-13 'Changes opening time for all Globex listed Dairy Futures and Options'), so the carry-back convention probably applies but the two notices should be read; (ii) REGULAR vs EXTENDED - the 2013-05-18 spec still shows 'OPEN OUTCRY (Trading Floor) MON-FRI: 9:05 a.m. - 1:10 p.m.' alongside the Globex line, so dairy WAS pit-eligible until CME closed most open outcry in 2015; the RTH window and its removal date both need sourcing before classification; (iii) Pre-Open onsets (schedule file shows Sun 16:00 CT / Mon-Thu 16:45 CT).

ROW 26 - LBR -> proposed `globex_lumber`. Grid: 'CME Globex Pre-Open: Monday - Friday: 6:00 a.m. - 9:00 a.m. Central Time/CT' and 'CME Globex: Monday - Friday: 9:00 a.m. - 3:05 p.m. CT', from CME Submission 22-248, effective Sunday 2022-08-07 for trade date Monday 2022-08-08; still 'Monday - Friday: 9:00 a.m. - 3:05 p.m. CT' in CME's spec captured 2026-06-20, and matching the 2026-08-30 schedule file exactly (Pre-Open 06:00, Ready 09:00, Close 15:05 CT). This is a whole sourced life: LBR is a NEW contract launched 2022, not the delisted Random Length Lumber (LBS, delisted 2022-07), so no pre-2022 history is inherited and the pre-launch era is a closure. NOTHING further is needed for the current grid.

ROW 26 - SYP -> the SAME `globex_lumber` key as LBR, but only after the source conflict below is resolved. For: CME's own Southern Yellow Pine FAQ, captured 2025-03-27 (four days before launch) and again 2026-05-21, says 'Trades may be entered on CME Globex Monday - Friday: 9:00 a.m. - 3:05 p.m. CT'; CME's product metadata gives SYP globexGroupCode 'LU' - the same Globex security group as LBR; Databento's April-2026 definitions place SYP in 70/LU; the 2026-08-30 schedule file gives LBR and SYP one identical signature. Against: CME Submission 25-082 (the initial-listing certification, effective Sunday 2025-03-30 for trade date Monday 2025-03-31) prints 'CME Globex: Sunday 5:00 p.m. - Friday 4:00 p.m. CT with a daily maintenance period from 4:00 p.m. - 5:00 p.m. CT' with a pre-open row reading 'Tuesday - Thursday 4:45 p.m. - 5:00 p.m. CT'. I judge that table to be a pasted 24-hour template (its 'Tuesday - Thursday' is itself wrong for CME), but I did not retrieve a document that corrects it, so the implementing session must settle it - see blockers.

ROW 39 - MFV (10-Ton Urea US Gulf, CBOT ch.48, group 70/UA) -> proposed `globex_urea_10_ton`. Grid: 'CME Globex Pre-Open: Monday through Friday 8:00 a.m. - 8:30 a.m. CT' and 'CME Globex: Monday 8:30 a.m. - Friday 2:30 p.m. CT', from CBOT Submission 25-177, effective Sunday 2025-06-01 for trade date Monday 2025-06-02. ROW 40 - CVB (Black Sea Wheat (CVB) Financially Settled (Argus), CBOT ch.14Y, group 70/BW) -> proposed `globex_black_sea_wheat_cvb`, with TWO fully dated eras already in hand. Era 1, from CBOT Submission 25-103, effective Sunday 2025-06-01 for trade date Monday 2025-06-02: 'CME Globex: Sunday - Friday, 7:00 p.m. - 7:45 a.m. CT / Monday - Friday, 8:30 a.m. - 1:20 p.m. CT', pre-opens 'Sunday: 4:00 p.m. - 7:00 p.m. CT / Monday - Thursday: 4:45 p.m. - 7:00 p.m. CT / Monday - Friday: 8:00 a.m. - 8:30 a.m. CT' - i.e. the standard CBOT grain grid. Era 2, from CBOT Submission 26-234, effective Sunday 2026-08-02 for trade date Monday 2026-08-03: expanded to 'Sunday - Friday 7:00 p.m. - 1:20 p.m.' with the 08:00-08:30 morning pre-open dropped; the filing prints the outgoing values in its 'Current' columns. That is exactly the 2026-08-30 schedule-file signature (Pre-Open Sun 16:00 / Mon-Thu 16:45, Ready 19:00, Halt 13:20 CT, six transitions, no 07:45 break - against the standard grains signature's nine). CVB therefore CANNOT reuse globex_grains: it coincided until 2026-08-03 and diverged on a dated day. Pre-launch era is a closure.
